LESSON: MELODY

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Creating and Performing
Topic 2.4: Melody

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Melody
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can a melody be made interesting?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the use of variation in composing a melody
2. compose a four-bar melody in F Major and 4 4 time
3. perform melodies in F major and 4 4 time
4. value the use of melody in Creative Arts and Sports
